items.description: SELF_DELETED is a dark cyberpunk interactive story about the price of identity.In the Lower City, debts are never forgiven. You have 30 minutes to pay 500,000 credits — or die.You have no money. Only a technology that allows you to sell your memories.Connected to a neural interface, you see your mind as a collection of files. Each memory has a price. The more it means to you, the higher its value.First love. Childhood rooftops. Your closest friend. Your mother. Your core identity.Once sold, the memory disappears forever. You won’t even remember what you lost.What are you willing to sacrifice to survive? And who will remain when it’s over?FeaturesCyberpunk interactive narrativeMoral choice systemAtmospheric soundtrackPsychological drama7 different endingsMultiple paths to losing yourselfSELF_DELETED is not a story about death. items.description: The game takes place on Earth in the distant future. The familiar world is threatened by a threat from the past. As it turned out, an ancient race of highly intelligent beings owned this world long before people. They called themselves "The Firstborn". But a few million years ago, a meteorite hit the Earth, destroying 90% of life on the planet and making it almost uninhabitable. To save their species, the originals had to go to sleep, hibernating their city for years to come.Kirk Hussl, a former Special Forces soldier and now a thief, received an order from an anonymous author for an interesting artifact hidden in the ocean. Having sailed to the coordinates indicated by the anonymous, he discovered an unusual crystal. Removing it with the bathyscaphe's manipulator, he provoked an explosion that damaged the power supply system of the hibernation pods in the city of the originals. From the explosion, Kirk falls in the bathyscaphe and hits his head, losing consciousness, but before that, having time to order the system to ascend. Kirk regains consciousness while in a local prison.A young girl, Zendaya, an antiquities hunter, goes to the ruins in search of "artifacts" that will pay well. Ancient treasure hunter. By nature, she is an adventurer, often looking for adventure in very dangerous places. Green-eyed brunette. Smart, well-built, she travels the world in search of various artifacts, she decides to explore the city of the originals that arose on the site of the ruins of Wilmington.An archeology student named Yoko leads his own personal investigation into the causes of the cataclysm. Everything that was dear to him, everyone he loved, died in this tragedy. He returned to the city to find out the truth about what happened and visit his ruined house. A typical nerd, somewhat naive and funny.Meanwhile, the ancient city of the first-born people, "Gentem", has risen from the abyss and ascended into the skies to find a new location on land, splashing out a wave of energy in the process that destroyed part of the east coast of the United States. The release was the result of a failed battery in one of the life support systems of the ancient city. The city of Wilmington fell into ruins, many people died, and the rest lost their homes. The ruined city became the new foundation for Gentem. The Originals decide to start a process of controlled terraforming of the Earth in order to bring the climate to a state suitable for them. This threatens the disappearance of all mankind from the face of the earth.Hussl breaks out of prison, and the ruins of Wilmington become the only place to hide. Meanwhile, Yoko is sent to investigate the scene of the tragedy, and Zendaya, the city itself. Chance brings all three heroes together. They learn about the plans of the originals and try to stop them.- The ruins of the city are waiting for you, in place of which there is now a completely different city - the City of the Firstborn who rose from the depths of the ocean; - Three characters whose story you have to reveal;- Dynamic battles with many unique abilities of all three characters;- The game world in the genre of metroidvania divided into 6 zones;- Memorable enemies;- Dynamic, fast-paced plot;- Ability to create items;- Heroes have unique skills of their own;- A variety of missions with intricate goals!- Very cool music! items.description: You, the legendary fighter from the space squad samurai KR-15, will have the last operation: Meet with an informant to get information about the head of the clan "Anonymous", This clan for many years holds martial law on all four planets in the distant solar system called Infinitium. You have been selected for this mission.Since you are one of the best fighters in the squad. You have a high mastery of the katana, your shurikens fly right on target! A complete set of samurai combat equipment from the future. Your ability to maneuver and quickly defeat enemies is always at a price. Mission: Get all the necessary information from the informant, and eliminate the head of the clan "Anonymous" and thereby end the war on all four planets. But not everything is so simple, in the end everything will not go as you expected! And you have to solve this problem. You can help your pet robot in the game, which is controlled exclusively by the second player, it will be even more interesting to play together! The robot has small arms, and is always in the air. Sometimes his help in the game is simply not replaceable! Play together! Exciting platformer:Your katana is very sharp and fast as a way to quickly destroy your opponents. With your legendary skills, you can use various ninja and samurai throwing objects, fight your way through bullets and traps, and defeat powerful enemies. It's time for the last mission. The beautiful and at the same time mysterious story of the main character will reveal his character in the plot. Some missions you have to perform on the spaceship of the main character.
